PDF A Divided-Screenwise Hierarchical Compositing for Sort-Last Parallel ...
Abstract In this work, to render at least 5123 voxel volumes in real-time, we have developed a sort-last parallel volume rendering method for distributed memory multiprocessors. Our sort-last method consists of two methods, Hsu's seg-mented ray casting and our divided-screenwise hierarchi-cal (DSH) compositing, in which each processor produces a subimage and merges all the produced subimages ...
